question: What ritual qualifications are attributed to the giver of the Śrī Cakra?
premises: The person is described as well-bathed at all sacred fords.
The person is described as initiated in all sacrifices.
inference: The giver possesses the merit of complete pilgrimage and full sacrificial initiation.
plain_english: He is as one well-bathed at all sacred fords and initiated in all sacrifices.
